observations: Rectangular dining table with a white top featuring a Greek key pattern border.
Six matching chairs with chrome-finished frames and beige/cream upholstery.
The table has thick, metallic/chrome legs.
A watermark 'TIMOLIZ FURN EMPIRE' is visible across the center of the image.
The setting appears to be an indoor residential or showroom space.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a top that resembles marble, but it could be a composite or laminate.

risks.risk: The table top may be faux marble (MDF with laminate) rather than solid stone.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge and the underside of the table top.

risks.risk: The chrome plating on the legs and chair frames may be peeling or rusted.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the joints and the base of the legs.

risks.risk: The chair upholstery may have stains, tears, or sagging not visible in the wide shot.
risks.proof: Individual photos of each chair seat and backrest.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the table top edge to verify if it is solid stone or a laminate.
Clear photos of all six chair seats to check for stains or damage.
Close-up photos of the metallic legs to check for rust or peeling chrome.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 6-seater dining set. It will be priced as a generic set with a faux-marble top and standard upholstery until higher quality materials are proven.
